question: The third battle of Panipat fought in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1761.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **third battle of Panipat **was fought in **1761.**
 
• This battle was fought between the **Maratha Empire **and the** Durrani Empire.**
 
• The Marathas were led by **Sadashivrao Bhau**, while the **Durrani Empire **was led by **Ahmad Shah Durrani.**
 
• The battle was one of the **largest and bloodiest** fought in the **18th century,** with an estimated **60,000 to 70,000 casualties.**
 
• The **Durrani Empire** emerged **victorious** in the battle, which had a significant impact on the **political and military landscape **of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The year **1556** is associated with the** Battle of Panipat.**

 
 
• It was fought between the **Mughal Empire** and the** forces of Hemu,** the Prime Minister of the** Kingdom of Delhi.**
 
• The **Mughals **emerged victorious in this battle.
 
 
 
• The year 1651 is **not associated **with any significant battle in the history of India.
 
• The year **1526** is associated with the **First Battle of Panipat.**
 
 
• It** **was fought between the **Mughal Empire** and the forces of **Ibrahim Lodi, the Sultan of Delhi.**
 
• The **Mughals **emerged victorious in this battle.
 
 
 
• The year **1761** is associated with the **Third Battle of Panipat**, as discussed above.
